step-1.text: Put the table top upside down on the flattened box. You will build the frame right on top of it.

step-2.text: Bolt a long rail between two legs, then do the same with the other pair. Two bolts at each joint. Leave them a little loose for now.

count-2.text: This step uses 4 legs, 2 long rails and 8 bolts.

step-3.text: Now join the two halves with the short rails, two bolts per joint. Square up the frame, then tighten every bolt.

count-3.text: This step uses 2 short rails and 8 bolts.

step-4.text: Center the frame on the top and drive the wood screws up through the rails into the top. Short screws only, so nothing pokes through.

step-5.text: With a helper, lift it and turn it right side up. Then sit down. You earned it.

count-5.text: Nothing new this step. Just you and the frame.

done.text: Done. Your INGO table is built. Give it a proud little pat.
